scheme_name: Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education
other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents must reside in Andhra Pradesh

Student must be pursuing a full‑time Vedic course (Yajur Veda, Rig Veda, Sama Veda, Atharvana Veda, or Smartham) at a Veda Pathasala registered with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD), the Endowments Department of Government of Andhra Pradesh, or enlisted by the A.P. Brahmin Welfare Corporation
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
For Padam, Kramam, Jata and Ghanam courses, the student must have completed the previous course of study
benefits_summary: Annual financial assistance of ₹12,000–₹36,000 is provided, varying with the specific Vedic course and the student’s age.
